name: What kind of materials are used for crown molding repair?

mainEntity.name: What kind of materials are used for crown molding repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The materials used for crown molding repair depend on the type of molding and the nature of the damage. Common materials include wood fillers or spackle for patching holes and cracks, specialized wood glue for reattaching loose sections, and caulk for sealing gaps. For replacement, we use new sections of molding made from materials such as MDF, solid wood, or polyurethane, carefully selected to match the existing profile and material. High-quality primer and paint are also used to achieve a consistent and durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair materials include wood fillers, glue, caulk, and new molding sections (MDF, wood, polyurethane) to match existing profiles, plus primer and paint.
